Daily crawl

Fresh from arXiv

An automated crawl scans new arXiv postings in eess.AS, cs.SD, cs.CL and cs.MM every day and flags anything that looks like a spoken-LLM benchmark. Flagged items are reviewed before they enter the catalogue above.
